reviews_used.author: Henry Romero
reviews_used.text: Great company!! Always committed to work and do it right. Best choice for all kinds of renovations. Highly recommend.

reviews_used.author: Francisco Delacruz
reviews_used.text: Excellent work and very dependable. They do renovations, demolition, plaster, painting, and flooring, plus light electrical and plumbing work. Everything was done cleanly, on time, and with great attention to detail. I'm very satisfied with the results and would definitely use them again.

reviews_used.author: Adrian Campos
reviews_used.text: Highly recommend! They handled my AC repairs with great care and professionalism. They were reliable, meticulous, and stuck to the schedule. I'm very satisfied and would definitely use them again.. gracias

research_notes: Busqueda profunda de email/redes: WebSearch de 'Alef general constructions LLC' + Miami/North Bay Village + email/instagram/facebook/BBB/thumbtack/angi/homeadvisor/nextdoor/sunbiz: ningun resultado coincide con esta empresa exacta (solo empresas homonimas no relacionadas: 'Alef Construction Group LLC' en North Miami Beach, 'Alfe LLC' en Saint Cloud, etc). Sunbiz no devolvio resultado accesible (403 al fetch directo). No se encontro Instagram, Facebook, Yelp, Linktree, Thumbtack, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BBB ni Nextdoor con el nombre exacto. La ficha de Google Maps (pestaña info) no expone email ni website (confirmado tambien por _gmaps_url_detail.js: website=null). Conclusion: email=null, outreach=pending_manual, canal de contacto es telefono (+1 305-986-8532) y la propia ficha de Google Maps (unico canal publico verificable).
address_decision: La direccion 7544 Adventure Ave, North Bay Village, FL 33141 SI es la direccion publica de la ficha de Google Maps de este negocio (campo 'address', no 'service area'), confirmada tambien por el fetch directo de Playwright. Se usa mapa embed real con esa direccion.
